about_the_game:
From the heart of the Hollow Lands, a new legend begins.

Primateria: Reburn is more than a collectible card game—it's an immersive TCG life simulator where lore, community, and strategy merge. Rise from casual card shop duelist to myth-forged champion in a vibrant magepunk world where cards aren't just paper—they’re the language of gods, dreams, and destiny.

The Journey: From Card Shop to Legend

  • Local Tournaments: Begin at The Ember Bloom or other cozy card shops. Weekly casuals, Swiss brackets, and mini-festivals await. Earn Reputation Points, rare cards, and Village Prestige.

  • Regionals: Travel across the Arcane Quarters—Wind, Water, and Fire-themed regions with unique metas and rotating rule sets.

  • Nationals: Enter floating cities, underwater halls, and arenas orbiting crystals. Face elite players, human and AI. Unlock Legendary Cards.

  • The Reverie Cup: The grand world championship—held in Auroria, a dream-bound city. Here, the battlefield shifts with your will. Only those who understand fate can become Primateria Ascendant.

Real TCG Progression Meets Magical Realism

  • Play casuals, climb ranked, explore varied formats (Highlander, Draft, Tag Duels, Budget, etc.).

  • Build decks around dream combos and test them across shops and events.

  • NPC duelists use competitive decks meticulously crafted.

  • Friends become rivals; rivals become legends.

The True Card Shop Feel

  • Talk meta with NPCs, trade cards, hang out while others duel.

  • Shops simulate real-world cultures: gossips, rivalries, surprise trades, player interactions.

  • Mini-events: someone pulls a chase card and offers it to you on the spot—or asks for yours.

  • Lend decks, borrow cards, or propose trades mid-session.

  • NPCs remember you. Relationships evolve, unlocking team events, tag duels, and story arcs.

Systems That Support the Fantasy

  • Pseudo-smartphone: See tournament rankings, achievements, local events, and your friend list.

  • Card Binder: View, filter, and sort your entire collection in-game without leaving the table.

  • Trade Groups: Post wants, respond to offers, and arrange in-person trades with NPCs.

  • Achievements unlock content: Defeat a boss? Gain access to rarer formats or legendary cards.

It’s More Than a Victory — It’s a Legacy

To win in Primateria isn’t just about numbers or titles. It’s about telling a story.

Your story.

One duel, one deck, one spark at a time.

Wishlist now to follow development and join our Discord / Bluesky for exclusive updates, alpha access, and sneak peeks!

  • Graphics: Direct X11 or Vulkan compatible GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
